source: Phase 2 insights (p2_q01, p2_q02, p2_q03, p2_q04, p2_q05)

risk_bands.recommendation: No action needed. Standard confirmation flow.
risk_bands.justification: Below the dataset base rate (~0.33) and consistent with observed low-risk profiles: lead time <= 30d, corporate segment, or 1+ special requests (Q02, Q03, Q05).

risk_bands.recommendation: Send proactive reconfirmation + flexible-date incentive (e.g., free date change).
risk_bands.justification: Mid-risk profiles: lead time 60-180d or online segment with no special requests (Q02: 28-45% observed rates in these bands).

risk_bands.recommendation: Assign retention workflow immediately: personal contact, deposit/penalty enforcement, and inventory reallocation review.
risk_bands.justification: High-risk profiles: lead time > 180d with zero engagement signals (Q02: ~74% observed rate; Q05: zero special requests = 43% base risk).

cost_matrix.justification: FN (missed cancellation): average booking value ~EUR 313 with ~38% of potential revenue lost (Q01); losing a room-night with no re-sell chance is expensive. FP (unnecessary retention action): cost of a reconfirmation call/incentive is small. Exact monetary calibration is unknown; 10:1 ratio documented as a conservative assumption pending finance validation.
cost_matrix.assumption_note: Bands and costs are assumptions derived from Phase 2 observed rates, not exact business figures.

decision_threshold_policy: Optimize the decision threshold on the validation set by minimizing expected cost using this cost matrix (never on the test set, G6).
